title: Concepts
description: Future project ideas in the assembled config: an array of concepts that keep their id, sorted by order ascending, then id. Each concept definition also describes its source file (config/concepts/<id>.json). Cross-record rules (unique ids across collections, unique orders, canonical order) are enforced by scripts/validate.mjs.

concept.description: A title only. kind is a semantic distinction (a real idea, or a placeholder slot), not styling. No descriptions, features, dates or commitments.

kind.description: concept: a project idea. placeholder: a slot that is not an idea yet.
